text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with secondary neuropathy.

I am concerned about the combination of a pruritic rash on the face/upper body and sensory symptoms in your palms, especially given your work with livestock. Are there any blisters or skin fragility on your hands, and have you noticed any dark urine or jaundice?
